messages:
maya: quick pollwe've got two directions for first-run help: (1) a tiny persistent 'Get started' pill in corner that expands to a checklist + samples, or (2) contextual inline hints that show only where the user hesitates. which wins for the console?
chris: pill. discoverable for non-devs, less magic. :+1:
anita: accessibility note: pill is easier to make keyboard/screen-reader reachable. inline hints often skip SR users unless anchored.
leo: mobile tradeoffpill takes space. compromise: icon-only collapsed on small widths.
sarah: copy: avoid "tour". options: "Get started", "Quickstart", "Starter". i prefer "Get started".
maya: also add snooze: 7/30 days so power users can dismiss.
chris: checklist order suggestion: samples before billing. early wins first.
anita: a11y nit: status badges must include text ("Complete"/"Incomplete") and be announced via role=status when updated.
leo: preload minimal sample metadata (~60KB gz) so opening is instant. feature-flag rollout.
sarah: sample CTA: "Run sample" (primary) + "Import project" (secondary). success toast: "Sample deployed  opened workspace".
maya: keyboard flow: focus pill, Enter opens, trap focus, Escape closes, first focus on checklist. add shortcut discovery in command palette.
chris: telemetry events: onboard.pill.open, onboard.sample.run, onboard.checklist.complete. rollout metric: checklist completion within 7 days.
anita: add A11y acceptance criteria to PR: keyboard walkthrough + SR announcement + contrast checks.
leo: estimate 3 dev days + 1 QA day.
maya: i'll prototype both Figma frames and tag design-review next Wed. design-bot: Figma uploaded https://www.figma.com/file/def/onboard-getstarted-pill (preview).
chris: tiny UX nit: panel should be position:fixed in portal so page doesn't jump.
anita: ensure role=dialog and aria-modal=true when open.
maya: thanks all, turning notes into spec now :sparkles:
